title: A new rule lands
story: The CFPB amends Reg E. Madison reads it, works out that it applies, finds the obligations, double-checks them, waits for Elena, matches them to Northgate's policies and controls, finds a gap and a drift, and shows the impact on the coverage field.

steps.do: Point at 'What changed this week', click 'Provisional credit for card and ACH disputes'
steps.see: Change room, Not started (0 of 6)

steps.do: Click 'Run Madison on this rule'
steps.see: The agentic change map comes alive: the rule text flows from eCFR, sections split, the scope check lights up

steps.do: Click the 'Find the obligations' platform while it works
steps.see: Side panel: each obligation with the rule's own words

steps.do: Watch the double-check gate hold one back; hover the held block
steps.see: Reason shown in plain words

steps.do: At 'You decide', press 'Accept 6 obligations and exclude 1'
steps.see: Decision side sheet; flow continues

steps.do: Watch policies and controls flow in; the drift appears
steps.see: 4 covered, 1 not yet confirmed, 1 gap; owner Margaret Ellison named

steps.do: Click 'Open in Coverage'
steps.see: Coverage flies to the Reg E plot; the new gap block is raised and red, owner shown

end: Reg E plot updated; task for Margaret Ellison created; record has signed entries
talk_track: Every step is checkable: click any platform
The gap has an owner and a deadline the moment it is found

title: Close a gap with a new control
story: MFA rule is 4 of 6 steps done. One obligation has nothing behind it. Madison drafts the smallest fix, runs seven design checks, asks the owner one question, gets the CCO's sign-off, and the coverage block turns green.

steps.do: Show the map: 4 platforms done, 'What's left' active with one red block
steps.see: Owner Priya Raman, deadline 1 Nov (Northgate) / 1 Dec (effective)

steps.do: Click 'Choose a fix'
steps.see: Control design platforms appear: suggest, draft, seven checks

steps.do: Watch D1 to D7 fill; D6 stops at 'can't tell'
steps.see: A handoff to Priya is created

steps.do: Switch to Priya Raman; open her task; answer
steps.see: Task drawer with what she was given and what she must provide

steps.do: Switch to Anthony Marsh; sign off
steps.see: CTL-153 goes into force

steps.do: Switch back to Elena; open Coverage
steps.see: The MFA block is green; 3 vendor reviews sent to Nadia Brennan

end: Gap closed, control in force, vendor reviews and a retest planned
talk_track: Design checks are visible, not a black box
People answer only what Madison cannot know

title: A handoff that unblocks a change
story: Loan Estimate rule is 3 of 6 steps done. Madison finds the procedure says 5 days where the rule says 3. Elena raises it to Grace; Grace responds; the change unblocks.

steps.do: Click 'Check coverage' on the Linked platform
steps.see: Policy, procedure and control stacks flow into the compare platform; drift shown with both numbers

steps.do: Choose 'Link and raise the drift'
steps.see: 'Blocked: waiting on Grace Liu' appears on the map

steps.do: Switch to Grace Liu; Today shows the task from Elena
steps.see: Drawer: three quotes given; new wording and date needed

steps.do: Fill the wording and date; press 'Update the procedure'
steps.see: Toast; record entry

steps.do: Switch back to Elena
steps.see: 'Grace Liu responded'; the map unblocks; obligation turns Covered

end: Drift fixed, obligation covered, both sides in the record
talk_track: Everyone sees what they were given and what they owe

title: Madison knows when a rule does not apply
story: Two quick contrasts: prepaid rule screened out with the bank fact that decided it; flood rule waiting on one bank fact that Grace answers.

steps.do: Open 'Prepaid account error resolution'
steps.see: Only the Applies platform, verdict 'Doesn't apply', the deciding fact (no prepaid accounts), certainty Clear

steps.do: Open 'Flood insurance'
steps.see: Applies platform waiting on a bank fact; handoff to Grace Liu

steps.do: Switch to Grace; answer 'Yes'
steps.see: Back as Elena: it now applies; obligations step unlocks

end: Two rules resolved without wasted work
talk_track: Madison does not create work for rules that do not bind you
